reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 0, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: Make a picture graph to show: cats: 1, dogs: 5, birds: 4, fish: 4. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: apples: 5, bananas: 3, mangoes: 8, grapes: 6. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: roses: 9, sunflowers: 9, tulips: 2, daisies: 3. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: Monday: 7, Tuesday: 8, Wednesday: 5, Thursday: 2. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: cats: 7, dogs: 1, birds: 10, fish: 10. Draw one 🍎 for each item.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The instruction 'Make a picture graph to show: cats: 1, dogs: 5, birds: 4, fish: 4. Draw one apple for each item' establishes an explicit one-icon-per-unit mapping with no scale factor, exactly matching 'present data in a pictograph without a scale'.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Category domains vary meaningfully across the five seeds -- animals (cats/dogs/birds/fish), fruits (apples/bananas/mangoes/grapes), flowers (roses/sunflowers/tulips/daisies), and weekdays (Monday-Thursday) -- so the pictograph-building task is exercised across distinct real-world subjects rather than one repeated dataset.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Seed 45's stem 'Monday: 7, Tuesday: 8, Wednesday: 5, Thursday: 2' gives no noun for what is being counted on each day, unlike the other four seeds where the counted item is explicit (cats, apples, roses), making this an unexplained quantity for a Grade 1 reader.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The four-category structure recurs, but the subject domain shifts convincingly between animals, fruit, flowers, and days across seeds 42-46, giving real contextual variety to what is otherwise a fixed pictograph-construction template.

competency_alignment.rationale: Every seed varies only the category set and the four counts to be graphed, e.g. seed 44's roses:9, sunflowers:9, tulips:2, daisies:3, which is precisely the 'given data, build an unscaled pictograph' skill this lc names.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Counts to be drawn range from 1, seed 42's cats:1, to 10, seed 46's birds:10 and fish:10, a hand-drawable one-icon-per-unit range appropriate for a Grade 1 no-scale pictograph.
